entries.title: AlphaRec
entries.reason: Text-representation and content-transfer comparator belongs to L4; it adds no required L2 architecture family.

entries.title: Item-Based Top-N Recommendation Algorithms
entries.reason: Valid item-based work but redundant after Sarwar supplies the required ItemCF mechanism.

entries.title: Deep & Cross Network for Ad Click Predictions
entries.reason: CTR-specific adjacent architecture is lower direct value than the required Wide & Deep and DeepFM records.

entries.title: SimpleX: A Simple and Strong Baseline for Collaborative Filtering
entries.reason: Adds no required family after BPR, NCF, LightGCN, and DirectAU are retained.

entries.title: XSimGCL: Towards Extremely Simple Graph Contrastive Learning for Recommendation
entries.reason: Incrementally redundant after SimGCL and LightGCL cover simple and spectral graph-contrastive controls.

entries.title: Towards Universal Sequence Representation Learning for Recommender Systems
entries.reason: Universal sequential/content-transfer learning is owned by L4.

entries.title: Large Language-Recommendation Assistant
entries.reason: LLM/sequential scope is optional compute-tier work and does not satisfy a missing L2 family.

entries.title: A-LLMRec: Large Language Models meet Collaborative Filtering: An Efficient All-round LLM-based Recommender System
entries.reason: LLM/content recommendation belongs to L4 and is not needed for locked L2 coverage.

entries.title: RHGCL: Representation-Driven Hierarchical Graph Contrastive Learning for User-Item Recommendation
entries.reason: Submitted/under-review ICLR 2026 record at cutoff and redundant after two final graph-contrastive controls; no stable publication record used.

entries.title: Textual Graph Contrastive Learning for Enhanced Dataset Recommendation
entries.reason: Recommends scientific datasets to papers and requires text/graph inputs; it is not a direct v5 product-item architecture control.

entries.title: Contrastive Graph Structure Learning via Information Bottleneck for Recommendation
entries.reason: Valid graph-contrastive augmentation work but adds no locked claim family beyond SimGCL and LightGCL.

entries.title: Knowledge Graph Preference Contrastive Learning for Recommendation
entries.reason: Requires an external knowledge graph not present in the locked interaction-only comparator contract.

entries.title: Theoretical Guarantees for LT-TTD: A Unified Transformer-based Architecture for Two-Level Ranking Systems
entries.reason: Unreviewed theoretical preprint with no incremental core claim beyond final two-stage/two-tower sources.

entries.title: The Case Against Generation for Retrieval: Discriminative Language Models as Effective Retrievers
entries.reason: Cutoff-current preprint using LLM backbones; optional LLM retrieval scope and no required L2 family gap.

entries.title: LLM-CoT Enhanced Graph Neural Recommendation with Harmonized Group Policy Optimization
entries.reason: Withdrawn ICLR 2026 submission and LLM/content/graph hybrid outside the bounded lane.

entries.title: GRank: Towards Target-Aware and Streamlined Industrial Retrieval with a Generate-Rank Framework
entries.reason: Preprint-only industrial retrieval work; ContextGNN and T2Diff already supply final recent controls with stable records.

entries.title: InteractRank: Personalized Web-Scale Search Pre-Ranking with Cross Interaction Features
entries.reason: Search pre-ranking system is adjacent and does not add a required recommender architecture family beyond retained retrieval/ranking controls.

entries.title: MixRec: Individual and Collective Mixing Empowers Data Augmentation for Recommender Systems
entries.reason: Data-augmentation contribution is not a missing architecture family and is redundant for the graph/contrastive control boundary.

entries.title: CALRec: Contrastive Alignment of Generative LLMs for Sequential Recommendation
entries.reason: Generative LLM sequential recommendation is L4/optional-compute scope, not a required L2 comparator.

entries.title: A General Theoretical Paradigm to Understand Two Tower Recommendation Models
entries.reason: ICLR 2026 submission status was not a stable final publication at screening; it adds no operational architecture-contract evidence needed here.

entries.title: On strong convergence of the two-tower model for recommender system
entries.reason: OpenReview identifies a desk-rejected ICLR 2022 submission; final published two-tower sources supply the required evidence.
